title: Script crash output can print the RPC URL with its API key: deliberate-buy, recover-sell-ladys, capture-launch, preflight and the two legacy scripts print the raw error (or its message), and an ethers HTTP error message ends with the request URL

evidence.note: log.error({err}) serializes the whole error and console.error prints err.message
log.fatal({err: err.message}); on success the script logs only the variable name of the endpoint (:201), so the key leaks only on a crash
each failed check prints reason and details; the reasons embed the ethers error message (AUD-DB-010 for the src side and the Telegram copy)
console.error("Audit failed:", e) with the full error (CONTRACTS slice file, recorded here as a sibling)
hosted RPC URLs carry the key in the path (/v2/YOUR_KEY); same at :54

evidence.ref: node rpc-reason-repro.js (registered under AUD-DB-010: loopback JSON-RPC server answering eth_chainId then HTTP 500, fake key in the URL path, ethers 6.16.0)
evidence.note: the SERVER_ERROR message ends with info={ "requestUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v2/<KEY>" }: the same error object reaches these script catch blocks

sibling_sites_checked: Every catch and log call in the 10 SCRIPTS files and the three contracts-tooling scripts. pause.ts and resume.ts log only status, response body, URL and error code (the dashboard URL holds no key by default). telegram-login.ts prints err.message of a Telegram error (no RPC URL). deploy-honeypot-checker.ts logs only the exit status of the Hardhat child; the child prints its own errors (Hardhat redacts nothing for us, recorded under AUD-CONTRACTS-004). The logger writes to stdout only (src/utils/logger.ts:6-10, no file transport), so the exposure is the terminal and anything that captures it.
severity_rationale: S3: a credential (RPC API key) reaches local terminal output only on an error path; no file, no Telegram (the Telegram copy is AUD-DB-010, S2). Risk grows when output is pasted into a chat, an issue or an agent transcript.
recommendation: Phase 29 together with the AUD-DB-010 fix (card TX-04 covers the src side): one shared redaction helper that strips URLs (or at least their path and query) from error messages and logged error objects, used by every script catch block.
